# Observability Quality & Cost

Monitor **telemetry completeness, workbook quality, alert hygiene, and Log Analytics cost**. Gaps here become Unknown health everywhere else; this page keeps the observability platform itself observable.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

## Observability quality & cost at a glance

Ingestion volume, billable split, and telemetry coverage of the monitoring estate.

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize ['Billable GB'] = round(sum(Quantity)/1024, 1)
| extend Metric = 'Billable GB'
| project Metric, Value = ['Billable GB']
content.title: Billable ingestion (selected window)
Billable vs non-billable

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity)/1024, 2) by DataType
| order by GB desc
| take 10
content.title: Top tables by ingestion

## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Observability Quality & Cost" and WorkbookPage == "Observability Quality & Cost"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

## Diagnostic-settings coverage

Resources missing diagnostics or sending to the wrong workspace produce Unknown health. This is the agent's top telemetry-coverage backlog.

> **Placeholder - Resources missing diagnostic settings**
>
> ARG cannot read diagnostic settings directly. Use the Azure Policy 'Deploy/Audit diagnostic settings' compliance state (policyresources) or a scheduled export to list resources without diagnostics, by type/subscription.
>
> Supply the tenant-specific data source, then replace this tile with the documented query. See `docs/data-sources.md`.

content.query:
union *
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(_ResourceId)
| summarize Records = count() by _ResourceId
| summarize ResourcesEmitting = dcount(_ResourceId)
content.title: Resources actively sending logs (sanity check)

content.json:
## Workspace inventory & ingestion

Which workspaces exist and how much they ingest. Spikes are cost and noise; drops are coverage loss.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| extend sku = tostring(properties.sku.name), retention = toint(properties.retentionInDays)
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| project name, location, sku, retention, Subscription
| order by name asc
content.title: Log Analytics workspaces

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize BillableGB = round(sum(Quantity)/1024, 3) by DataType
| order by BillableGB desc
| take 25
content.title: Ingestion volume by table

Cost driver breakdown and daily ingestion trend. Use with commitment-tier sizing.

| order by TimeGenerated asc

## Collection coverage

Data Collection Rule coverage and agent (AMA) heartbeat failures. Missing DCRs and dead agents are silent coverage holes.

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, Category
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(15m)
| order by LastHeartbeat asc
content.title: AMA heartbeat failures (stale machines)

## App Insights coverage

Applications actively reporting vs the expected set. A silent app is Unknown, not healthy.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AppRoleName
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Applications reporting telemetry

## Alert hygiene

Duplicate/noisy alert rules and rules missing routing. Poor hygiene trains people to ignore alerts.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend rule = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule)
| summarize Fires = count() by rule
| order by Fires desc
| take 25
content.title: Noisiest alert rules

### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
